summary: WHISPERS: Realm of the Nine is a fantasy MMO across the streamed Lantern March continent, entered through a realm-gate menu and character creation. MMORPG Tools coordinates character persistence, lifecycle and modular UI; an ordered player behavior chain drives movement, classes, quests, commerce and gryphon travel. Procedural terrain and builders shape the continent, while regional data and UI present its frontiers.
places: places/main-menu-land/ - realm-gate front door, roster and menu UI; Enter World and Create lead to gameplay or character creation.
places/character-creation-land/ - race/class/appearance creation scene with preview model, lighting and creation camera.
places/main/ - streamed Lantern March continent, bounded by the Shrouded Sea; config owns procedural terrain/coast, roads, scatter, atmosphere and clearings.
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene - Lantern's Reach hub: square, inn, smith/merchant services, residents, quest interactions and armory display.
places/main/cells/ - regional cells hold Briarwild, Emberstone Quarry, Windmill Farm, settlements, race starts, landmarks and Ninth Veil/Ashfall frontiers, including gryphon-roost sites.
roots: world.config.yaml - main-menu-land default entry; binds player/camera templates, MMORPG UI, arrival redirect, routing and realm pulse.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/mod.json - registers MMORPG lifecycle, camera, character and interaction behaviors plus UI actions including flyTo/flightClose.
templates/player.js#player - ordered locomotion, movement, Vanguard, Arcanist, Pathfinder, quests, vendor, then flight behavior.
templates/camera.js#camera - core camera template; MMORPG gameplay/creation/menu cameras and wow-camera-controls provide separate framing/control paths.
places/main/config.yaml - continent spawn, gravity, expanded terrain/coast, material layers, roads, flattening and scatter bindings.
mods/gavi/mod.json - registers Gavi crew behavior and panel; companion commands and skills define builder-facing tools.
shared: mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/lib/ - RPG registries, persistence, currency and UI panels reused by mod behaviors, gameplay scripts and ui.js.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/lib/realm-save.js - per-realm character load/upsert/delete and roster population shared by menu and player lifecycle.
scripts/lib/data/realms.yml - routing and realm-pulse room registry; realm-save.js separately defines room IDs that must align.
scripts/lib/data/quests.yml + MMORPG lib/quest-data.js - quest definitions/status shared by quest-player, quest-giver UI and HUD.
scripts/lib/economy.js + MMORPG lib/currency.js - copper movements/ledger and denomination formatting shared by quests, vendor, flight and UI.
scripts/lib/regions.js + scripts/terrain-reach.js - regional classification and terrain/coast generation used by continent systems and region display.
scripts/lib/data/flights.yml - roost coordinates, region labels, discovery radius, fare/speed limits and flight clearance read by scripts/flight.js and flight UI data.

scripts/gen/shape.js and gen/house.js, hamlet.js, props.js, tree.js, rock.js, spire.js, farm.js, windmill*, frontier.js, briar.js, quarry.js, reach-* and elder-tree.js - reusable procedural geometry builders.
notableExports: scripts/arrival.js - onArrive, onLeave; scripts/routing.js - pickRoom; crons/realm-pulse.js - cron.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/main-menu-mgr.js - roster selection/hydration and lifecycle; character-select.js - preview lifecycle and input handling.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/player.js - character build/save/load and gameplay lifecycle; scripts/player.js - onInput/update; scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js - gait behavior.

mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/ui.js - UI composition/actions; lib/ui-flight.js - renderFlightMap; lib/ui-zone-splash.js - renderZoneSplash, resetZoneSplash, zoneSplashActive, zoneArtFor; lib/version.js - GAME_VERSION 0.9.8 Alpha, GAME_TITLE and versionTag.
scripts/flight.js - onInput/update; scripts/gryphon-flight.js - at/update for deterministic gryphon path and rider landing; scripts/lib/regions.js - REGIONS, MARCH, regionAt.
scripts/quest-player.js - onInput/update; scripts/elric.js and scripts/townsfolk.js - resident behavior; scripts/lib/economy.js - realmOf, ledger, feedback, move.
scripts/gen/elder-tree.js - geometry/collider; scripts/wolves.js, vanguard.js, arcanist.js and pathfinder.js - creature/combat behaviors.
mods/gavi/equipe.js - crew-watch/target behavior; mods/gavi/painel-equipe.js - panel renderer.
ownership: scripts/player.js - room-local movement intent and velocity/footstep state; place config owns gravity.
scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js - transient gait/turn state, character yaw and animation channels; gait samples prior-tick movement velocity.
MMORPG player.js and lib/realm-save.js - active character, roster snapshots and persisted character records, including discovered roost IDs; menu/character-select own front-door transitions.
scripts/vanguard.js, arcanist.js and pathfinder.js - class action/cooldown/combat state; scripts/wolves.js owns pack AI and den/death timers.
scripts/quest-player.js - player quest, tally, inventory/xp/dialog/cache state; scripts/woodcutting.js owns tree fall/regrowth presentation.
scripts/lib/economy.js - coin movement, purse floor and ledger writes; scripts/vendor.js owns shop state and transaction handling.
scripts/flight.js - per-player discovered roosts, flightMap, flying/landing state and nearby-roost hint; scripts/gryphon-flight.js owns spawned mount route and rider landing.
MMORPG ui.js/lib/ui-* render player/mod state; ui-zone-splash.js owns transient client splash timing/art selection; Gavi equipe.js owns crew-watch/target state.
flows: world.config.yaml defaultPlace main-menu-land → main-menu-mgr/main-menu UI → realm roster or character selection → creation/enter-world → main gameplay lifecycle.
Arrival outside main-menu-land without fresh _worldEnterAt or creation-place _creationEnterAt → scripts/arrival.js redirects to main-menu-land; menu Enter/Create stamp the transition exceptions.
main-menu-mgr loads current room SQL roster and population; api.enterPlace routes selected character to saved place/position; routing validates requested room, then last room, then main.
scripts/routing.js and crons/realm-pulse.js read realms.yml; room cron writes player count to realm_pulse, which realm-save reads for roster UI.
Character creation race/class → lib/races.js race start and character state → MMORPG player.js/realm-save upsert to realm characters table, keyed by user, realm and slot.
templates/player.js → humanoid-locomotion → player → Vanguard → Arcanist → Pathfinder → quest-player → vendor → flight; preserve behavior order and shared inputs.
moveX/moveZ/jump and orbit/steer/autorun → player.js and wow-move.js room-local intent → body motion under place gravity; camera controls consume camera/player state separately.
Attack/cast inputs → class abilities and scripts/lib/missiles.js → targets/wolves; wolf slow/hit state is consumed by wolves.js.
Interact/E → quest-player resolves NPCs, talkers, readable props, caches and timber; quests.yml via quest-data drives accept/turn-in/progress and UI.

Quest accept/complete UI → quest-player; completion records claim before reward, saves character state and pays copper through economy.move; vendor UI actions similarly route purchases/sales through economy.
scripts/flight.js discovers nearby roosts into state.roosts → MMORPG player persistence saves/loads them; E at a roost writes flightMap, rendered by ui.js/lib/ui-flight.js.

flightMap flyTo {id} action → scripts/flight.js validates discovered destination, charges economy.move, spawns scripts/gryphon-flight.js mount and parents rider → mount lands rider and clears flying; ui-zone-splash waits until landing and displays regional art.
behaviorFamilies: scripts/gen/house.js, hamlet.js, props.js, tree.js, rock.js, spire.js, farm.js, windmill*, frontier.js, briar.js, quarry.js, reach-*, elder-tree.js and roost.js - procedural builders recur across placed instances, varied by kind, seed and parameters.
scripts/grass.js, flower.js, mushroom.js and pebble.js - terrain scatter geometry reused by place bindings, varied by layer density, scale, seed or per-item params.
scripts/gen/tree.js with scripts/tree-look.js - painted bark/alpha-cut foliage recur in forest layers and placed scatters, varied by tree kind and LOD.
scripts/flower.js and mushroom.js with their look materials - painted wildflower frames and mushroom caps vary by frame/cap parameters in terrain scatter.
MMORPG player.js, character-select.js and main-menu-mgr.js - coordinated character/menu lifecycle registered by mod.json.
MMORPG camera.js/camera-creation.js and menu-camera.js - gameplay, creation-preview and per-screen menu camera paths with phase/place guards.
MMORPG lib/ui-*.js - modular renderers composed by ui.js for HUD, menu/roster, quests, vendor, flight map, zone splashes, inventory, map, character and settings.

scripts/vanguard.js, arcanist.js and pathfinder.js; wolves.js, quest-player.js, townsfolk.js, vendor.js, woodcutting.js and flight.js - gameplay behaviors vary by class, target tags and per-player/NPC state.
migrationNotes: Money is one integer copper amount; 100 copper = 1 silver and 100 silver = 1 gold. Route flight and all other transactions through scripts/lib/economy.js to preserve purse floor, ledger and UI feedback.
templates/player.js behavior order is significant: locomotion before movement, then classes, quests, vendor and flight; gait samples prior-tick velocity.
Movement intent/locomotion scratch is room-local ctx.session; scripts/player.js writes velocity while place config owns gravity.
Flight roost ids in flights.yml must correspond to flattened pads and ground y values in main config; saved state.roosts is the discovery record, with coordinates in place-main meters.

Region splash art coverage/priority lives separately from scripts/lib/regions.js; ui-zone-splash.js has its own circle/band boundaries, and arrays alternate paintings per region, so keep splash mappings and actual region names/bounds aligned when editing.
Realm routing/pulse and realm-save use separate room-ID sources; arrival also depends on paired _worldEnterAt/_creationEnterAt transition stamps and grace checks.
